name: IllumiNeRF
definition: A 3D relighting pipeline that reconstructs a relightable 3D representation from posed input images under unknown lighting by generating multiple plausible relit images via a diffusion model and distilling them into a consistent 3D latent NeRF, avoiding inverse rendering.
summary: IllumiNeRF is a 3D relighting pipeline that avoids inverse rendering by distilling multiple diffusion-generated relit images into a consistent latent NeRF for novel viewpoint synthesis.
